newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Suncorp plans A$2.2 billion refinancing facility.
newsitem.headline: Suncorp plans A$2.2 billion refinancing facility.

text.p: Queensland financial services group Suncorp Metway Ltd said it expected to announce on Tuesday a new A$2.2 billion refinancing facility with a group of 26 banks.
"On Monday in Hong Kong we will sign up for a very large new facility with 26 banks," Suncorp Metway's acting chief financial officer, Caji DeSouza told the Business Queensland newspaper.
A Suncorp Metway spokeswoman confirmed an announcement on the new facility would be made tomorrow.
DeSouza told the newspaper the 26-bank syndicate had previously advanced A$740 million to Metway.
"They have now agreed to increase that facility to US$1.5 billion (A$2.2 billion) which we can draw upon over the next three years," he said.
"We won't be drawing it all at once," DeSouza said.
Suncorp Metway Ltd is 67 percent-owned by the Queensland state government which has committed to reduce its stake to 15 percent within five years.
